serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Elvo is a clinician-directed platform that supports evidence-based at-home data collection and exercise programs between skilled therapy visits, during telehealth visits, or other use cases as deemed appropriate by clinicians. For example, clinicians create home exercise programs; the platform can then deliver them through a customized interface and records objective session metrics. Those metrics can for example combine quantitative performance data with standardized qualitative ratings. The platform is highly evidence-based. It operationalizes documented protocols rather than introducing new treatment methods.
